figurative_meaning_en: A substance that removes bad odor from the mouth
example_sentences_in_bangla: খাবার খাওয়ার পর মুখশুদ্ধি করলে সুবিধা হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Using mouth freshener after eating is beneficial.
Use mouth freshener after chewing paan.
note: This is a compound term commonly used in Bengali for oral hygiene products, reflecting cultural emphasis on cleanliness.
